title: Understanding Risk of a Calendar Put Debit Spread
summary: I will keep numbers simple.Buying a put for $600 strike, dated 5 days out to expiration.Sold a put for $595 strike, dated 3 days out to expiration.The underlying tanks to $592.Let's say it is 1 day to expiration in this scenario. The put I sold has a total value of $6, though it is $3 ITM. I want to hold it until expiration to capture more extrinsic value / decay.Being 1 day until expiration, what is the risk here of early assignment? I feel the buyer would be foolish and should just sell. I want to hold as long as possible capture the remaining time decay gain.submitted by/u/Fogerty45[link][comments]
